The '''Agash system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained a single [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui]]. Its primary [[Star/Legends|star]] was the [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] [[Agash]].
